questions.prompt: What are the positive and negative things about the Internet?

vocabulary.title: Q1 - Positives and Negatives of the Internet
sentenceStarters: The Internet is arguably the most transformative...
On the positive side, it has democratised access...
On the negative side, the same openness...

questions.sampleBand5: Well, um, the internet is, like, good because you can, like, find information really fast. But, um, it can be a bit dangerous, I think. Yes, people can, um, get into your computer.
questions.sampleBand6: Okay, so the internet has some good and bad sides. Positively, it's a great resource for learning and communication. I mean, you can look up almost anything. However, there's definitely a downside. There's a lot of misinformation and, you know, online bullying is a real problem. So, yeah, it's a mixed bag.
questions.sampleBand7: Well, obviously, the internet has revolutionised communication and access to information, which is a huge plus. You can keep in touch with people all over the world and learn about almost anything. However, there are downsides too. I think the spread of misinformation and the potential for privacy breaches are major concerns. It's also quite addictive, which can take its toll.
questions.sampleBand8: The internet, without a doubt, has transformed our lives, offering incredible opportunities for learning, communication, and commerce. The ability to access information at your fingertips is invaluable. However, this convenience comes at a price. The spread of fake news and the erosion of privacy are significant drawbacks. It's a double-edged sword, really, offering immense benefits but also posing serious risks if not used responsibly. It's easy to get sucked into pointless content, too.
questions.sampleBand9: The internet presents a complex tapestry of benefits and drawbacks. On the one hand, it's an unparalleled tool for democratising knowledge and fostering global connectivity. We can reach out to people across continents and access information that was previously unimaginable. However, this accessibility has a dark side. The proliferation of misinformation, the erosion of privacy, and the potential for cybercrime are serious challenges. Moreover, the addictive nature of social media can lead to social isolation and mental health issues. In a nutshell, navigating the internet requires a critical and discerning approach, balancing the potential for empowerment with a healthy dose of skepticism. It requires careful consideration.
questions.sampleAnswer: The Internet is arguably the most transformative technology of the modern era, and its effects are genuinely double-edged. On the positive side, it has democratised access to information and knowledge on an unprecedented scale—anyone with a connection can access the accumulated knowledge of humanity, communicate with people anywhere in the world, and participate in global conversations that were previously impossible. It has created new forms of economic opportunity, enabled remote work, and made countless services more efficient and accessible. On the negative side, the same openness that makes the Internet powerful also makes it a vehicle for misinformation, extremism, and manipulation. The business models of major platforms—built around capturing and monetising attention—have created incentive structures that prioritise engagement over truth and wellbeing. There are also serious concerns about privacy, surveillance, and the concentration of power in the hands of a small number of technology companies. I think the Internet's effects on mental health—particularly for young people—are a growing concern that deserves more serious attention than it currently receives.
questions.uzSampleBand5: Xo'sh, internet, xuddi, yaxshi, chunki siz, xuddi, ma'lumotni juda tez topishingiz mumkin. Lekin, xuddi, u biroz xavfli bo'lishi mumkin, deb o'ylayman. Ha, odamlar, xuddi, sizning kompyuteringizga kirib olishi mumkin.
questions.uzSampleBand6: Xo'p, internetning yaxshi va yomon tomonlari bor. Ijobiy tomoni shundaki, u o'rganish va muloqot uchun katta resurs. Ya'ni, deyarli hamma narsani qidirib topishingiz mumkin. Biroq, albatta, yomon tomoni ham bor. Ko'p noto'g'ri ma'lumotlar bor va, bilasizmi, onlayn bezorilik haqiqiy muammo. Xullas, ha, bu aralash narsa.
questions.uzSampleBand7: Xo'sh, albatta, internet aloqa va ma'lumotga kirishni inqilob qildi, bu juda katta plyus. Siz butun dunyo bo'ylab odamlar bilan aloqada bo'lishingiz va deyarli hamma narsa haqida bilib olishingiz mumkin. Biroq, yomon tomonlari ham bor. Menimcha, noto'g'ri ma'lumotlarning tarqalishi va maxfiylikning buzilishi ehtimoli asosiy xavotirlar. Bundan tashqari, u juda ham o'rganib qolish mumkin, bu esa o'z ta'sirini o'tkazishi mumkin.
questions.uzSampleBand8: Internet, shubhasiz, hayotimizni o'zgartirdi, o'rganish, muloqot va tijorat uchun ajoyib imkoniyatlarni taqdim etdi. Ma'lumotga qo'l ostida kirish imkoniyati bebahodir. Biroq, bu qulaylikning o'z narxi bor. Soxta yangiliklarning tarqalishi va maxfiylikning yo'qolishi sezilarli kamchiliklardir. Bu ikki tomonlama qilich, aslida, ulkan foyda keltirib, mas'uliyat bilan foydalanilmasa, jiddiy xavflarni ham tug'diradi. Bundan tashqari, bema'ni kontentga berilib ketish oson.
questions.uzSampleBand9: Internet foyda va kamchiliklarning murakkab to'plamini taqdim etadi. Bir tomondan, bu bilimni demokratlashtirish va global aloqani rivojlantirish uchun beqiyos vositadir. Biz qit'alar bo'ylab odamlarga murojaat qilishimiz va ilgari tasavvur qilib bo'lmaydigan ma'lumotlarga kirishimiz mumkin. Biroq, bu qulaylikning qorong'u tomoni ham bor. Noto'g'ri ma'lumotlarning ko'payishi, maxfiylikning yo'qolishi va kiberjinoyatchilik ehtimoli jiddiy muammolar. Bundan tashqari, ijtimoiy tarmoqlarning o'rganib qolish xususiyati ijtimoiy izolyatsiyaga va ruhiy salomatlik muammolariga olib kelishi mumkin. Qisqasi, internetda harakatlanish tanqidiy va farqlash yondashuvni talab qiladi, imkoniyat berish potentsialini sog'lom skeptisizm bilan muvozanatlashtiradi. Bu ehtiyotkorlik bilan ko'rib chiqishni talab qiladi.
questions.uzSampleAnswer: Internet, ehtimol, zamonaviy davrning eng o'zgartiruvchi texnologiyasidir va uning ta'siri haqiqatan ham ikki tomonlama. Ijobiy tomoni shundaki, u misli ko'rilmagan miqyosda ma'lumot va bilimga kirishni demokratlashtirdi - aloqasi bor har bir kishi insoniyatning to'plangan bilimlariga kirishi, dunyoning istalgan nuqtasidagi odamlar bilan muloqot qilishi va ilgari imkonsiz bo'lgan global suhbatlarda ishtirok etishi mumkin. U yangi iqtisodiy imkoniyatlar yaratdi, masofaviy ishni ta'minladi va ko'plab xizmatlarni yanada samarali va qulay qildi. Salbiy tomoni shundaki, Internetni kuchli qiladigan o'sha ochiqlik uni noto'g'ri ma'lumot, ekstremizm va manipulyatsiya vositasiga aylantiradi. Yirik platformalarning biznes modellari - e'tiborni jalb qilish va monetizatsiya qilishga asoslangan - haqiqat va farovonlikdan ko'ra jalb qilishni ustuvor qiladigan rag'batlantiruvchi tuzilmalarni yaratdi. Shuningdek, maxfiylik, kuzatuv va bir nechta texnologiya kompaniyalarining qo'lida hokimiyatning to'planishi haqida jiddiy xavotirlar mavjud. Menimcha, Internetning ruhiy salomatlikka ta'siri, ayniqsa yoshlar uchun, hozirgidan ko'ra jiddiyroq e'tiborga loyiq bo'lgan o'sib borayotgan muammo.

questions.prompt: How will the Internet develop in the future?

vocabulary.title: Q2 - Future of the Internet
phrases: integration of digital and physical life
sentenceStarters: I think the Internet's development will be shaped...
Artificial intelligence will become increasingly integrated...
I think the most important and uncertain question...

questions.sampleBand5: Well, um, I think the internet will be, like, more faster. And, um, maybe more people will use it. I think it will be, uh, everywhere. Like, in everything. Yeah, um, easy to use.
questions.sampleBand6: I think the internet will become even more integrated into our daily lives. Probably, we'll see faster speeds and more devices connected. Um, it might also become more personalized, with AI picking up on our preferences. However, there could be some issues with privacy, I think.
questions.sampleBand7: Well, certainly, I expect the internet to become even faster and more accessible. We'll likely see a greater emphasis on mobile technology and the Internet of Things. In addition to that, I believe that artificial intelligence will play a much larger role in shaping our online experiences, although there might be some security concerns to address.
questions.sampleBand8: I imagine the internet will continue to evolve at a rapid pace. We're already seeing the rise of 5G, so faster connectivity is definitely on the horizon. Moreover, I think augmented and virtual reality will become more mainstream, offering immersive online experiences. The challenge, however, will be ensuring digital inclusion and combating misinformation, which are easier said than done. We also need to consider the ethical implications of AI-driven internet services.
questions.sampleBand9: It's likely the internet will undergo a profound transformation, becoming even more ubiquitous and seamlessly integrated into our lives. We can anticipate further advancements in areas like quantum computing and blockchain, which could lead to more secure and decentralized online systems. Looking ahead, the metaverse and Web3 technologies could fundamentally reshape how we interact online, blurring the lines between the physical and digital worlds. Ultimately, the key will be to harness these innovations responsibly, addressing issues like digital equity and data sovereignty to ensure a more inclusive and human-centered internet. The potential is immense, but with great power comes great responsibility.
questions.sampleAnswer: I think the Internet's development over the next decade or two will be shaped by several converging trends that are already visible. Artificial intelligence will become increasingly integrated into the fabric of the Internet—not just as a tool you use but as an ambient presence that shapes what you see, what you're recommended, and how information is generated and filtered. The Internet of Things will continue to expand, connecting more and more physical objects and environments to digital networks. Connectivity will become more pervasive—faster, more reliable, and available in more places—which will enable new applications and deepen the integration of digital and physical life. There are also important questions about governance and regulation—whether the Internet will become more fragmented along national lines, with different countries imposing different rules and restrictions, or whether some form of global governance framework will emerge. I think the most important and uncertain question is how AI will change the nature of online information—if AI can generate convincing content at scale, the challenge of distinguishing truth from fabrication will become significantly more difficult, with profound implications for democracy and public discourse.
questions.uzSampleBand5: Xo'sh, mm, menimcha internet, masalan, yanada tezroq bo'ladi. Va, mm, balki ko'proq odamlar undan foydalanishadi. Menimcha, u hamma joyda bo'ladi. Masalan, hamma narsada. Ha, mm, ishlatish oson.
questions.uzSampleBand6: Menimcha, internet bizning kundalik hayotimizga yanada ko'proq integratsiya qilinadi. Ehtimol, biz tezroq tezliklarni va ko'proq qurilmalarni ulanganini ko'ramiz. Mm, u shaxsiy afzalliklarimizni aniqlab oladigan sun'iy intellekt bilan yanada moslashtirilgan bo'lishi mumkin. Biroq, maxfiylik bilan bog'liq ba'zi muammolar bo'lishi mumkin, deb o'ylayman.
questions.uzSampleBand7: Xo'sh, albatta, men internet yanada tezroq va osonroq bo'lishini kutaman. Biz, ehtimol, mobil texnologiyalarga va Narsalar internetiga katta e'tibor berilishini ko'ramiz. Bundan tashqari, men sun'iy intellekt bizning onlayn tajribalarimizni shakllantirishda ancha katta rol o'ynaydi deb o'ylayman, garchi hal qilinishi kerak bo'lgan ba'zi xavfsizlik muammolari bo'lishi mumkin.
questions.uzSampleBand8: Tasavvur qilamanki, internet tez sur'atlar bilan rivojlanishda davom etadi. Biz allaqachon 5G ning yuksalishini ko'rmoqdamiz, shuning uchun tezroq ulanish, albatta, oldinda. Bundan tashqari, men kengaytirilgan va virtual reallik yanada ommalashadi va immersiv onlayn tajribalarni taklif qiladi deb o'ylayman. Biroq, muammo raqamli inklyuzivlikni ta'minlash va noto'g'ri ma'lumotga qarshi kurashish bo'ladi, buni aytgandan ko'ra qilish osonroq. Biz sun'iy intellektga asoslangan internet xizmatlarining axloqiy oqibatlarini ham ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.
questions.uzSampleBand9: Ehtimol, internet chuqur o'zgarishlarga duch keladi, yanada keng tarqalgan va hayotimizga uzluksiz integratsiya qilinadi. Biz kvant hisoblash va blokcheyn kabi sohalarda yanada rivojlanishlarni kutishimiz mumkin, bu esa yanada xavfsiz va markazsizlashtirilgan onlayn tizimlarga olib kelishi mumkin. Kelajakka nazar tashlasak, metaolam va Web3 texnologiyalari onlayn muloqot qilish usulimizni tubdan o'zgartirishi, jismoniy va raqamli dunyolar o'rtasidagi chegaralarni xiralashtirishi mumkin. Oxir-oqibat, asosiy narsa bu innovatsiyalardan mas'uliyat bilan foydalanish, raqamli tenglik va ma'lumotlar suvereniteti kabi masalalarni hal qilish orqali yanada inklyuziv va inson markazli internetni ta'minlash bo'ladi. Potentsial juda katta, lekin katta kuch bilan katta mas'uliyat keladi.
questions.uzSampleAnswer: Menimcha, kelgusi o'n yoki yigirma yil ichida Internetning rivojlanishi allaqachon ko'rinib turgan bir nechta tendentsiyalar bilan belgilanadi. Sun'iy intellekt Internetning tarkibiga tobora ko'proq integratsiya qilinadi - nafaqat siz foydalanadigan vosita sifatida, balki siz ko'radigan, sizga tavsiya qilinadigan va ma'lumot qanday yaratilishi va filtrlanganligini shakllantiradigan ambient mavjudlik sifatida. Narsalar interneti (Internet of Things) kengayishda davom etadi, tobora ko'proq fizik ob'ektlar va muhitlarni raqamli tarmoqlarga ulaydi. Ulanish tobora kengroq bo'ladi - tezroq, ishonchliroq va ko'proq joylarda mavjud - bu yangi ilovalarni yoqadi va raqamli va jismoniy hayotning integratsiyasini chuqurlashtiradi. Shuningdek, boshqaruv va tartibga solish bo'yicha muhim savollar mavjud - Internet turli xil qoidalar va cheklovlar o'rnatadigan turli mamlakatlar bilan milliy yo'nalishlar bo'ylab ko'proq bo'linib ketadimi yoki global boshqaruv tizimining bir turi paydo bo'ladimi. Menimcha, eng muhim va noaniq savol - sun'iy intellekt onlayn ma'lumotning mohiyatini qanday o'zgartiradi - agar sun'iy intellekt miqyosda ishonchli kontentni yaratishi mumkin bo'lsa, haqiqatni soxtalashtirishdan ajratish muammosi sezilarli darajada qiyinlashadi, bu esa demokratiya va ommaviy munozaralar uchun chuqur oqibatlarga olib keladi.

questions.prompt: Do you think you use the Internet too much?

vocabulary.title: Q3 - Using the Internet Too Much
sentenceStarters: Honestly, yes—and I think this is a question...
I've become more conscious of this over time...
I think the key distinction is between...

questions.sampleBand5: Well, um, I think maybe yes. I spend time online every day. It's, um, for work and, like, for fun. So, yeah, probably too much. I use it to look up things.
questions.sampleBand6: Um, honestly, I think I probably do. I mean, it's hard not to these days, right? I need it for my job and, of course, to keep in touch with friends. I guess I could cut down on social media, but it's quite addictive.
questions.sampleBand7: Yes, I'm fairly certain I do. It's a necessary evil, I suppose, because I need it for work and studies. I also use it for entertainment, like streaming movies and TV shows. However, I do try to limit my screen time when I can, but it's not always easy. It's a constant battle.
questions.sampleBand8: I'd say I probably use the Internet more than I should. It's become such an integral part of modern life, especially for work and communication. That said, I'm aware of the potential downsides, like eye strain and the rabbit hole of social media. So, I actively try to switch off and engage in other activities, such as reading or going for a walk, to maintain a healthy balance. I definitely think I could be more disciplined.
questions.sampleBand9: Without a doubt, I suspect I use the Internet to excess. It's an indispensable tool for my profession, and I also rely on it for staying connected and informed. Nevertheless, I'm acutely aware of the potential for it to eat into my time and distract me from more meaningful pursuits. The key is to find a sustainable balance, and I'm constantly striving to wean myself off excessive screen time by consciously engaging in offline activities. I'm trying to be more mindful and break the habit of mindless browsing.
questions.sampleAnswer: Honestly, yes—and I think this is a question that most people who reflect on it would answer the same way. The Internet, and particularly social media and news platforms, are designed with considerable sophistication to maximise the time you spend on them, and I find that I sometimes use them in ways that are habitual rather than intentional—reaching for my phone out of boredom or anxiety rather than genuine need. I've become more conscious of this over time and have tried to be more deliberate about my usage—turning off notifications, setting aside phone-free periods, and being more intentional about what I'm actually trying to accomplish when I go online. I think the key distinction is between using the Internet as a tool—to accomplish something specific—and using it as a default activity to fill time or manage discomfort. The former is genuinely valuable; the latter tends to leave me feeling more distracted and less satisfied than before. I don't think the solution is to avoid the Internet, which is neither realistic nor desirable, but to develop a more intentional and conscious relationship with it.
questions.uzSampleBand5: Xullas, e-e, menimcha, balki ha. Men har kuni onlaynda vaqt o'tkazaman. Bu, e-e, ish uchun va, masalan, qiziqarli narsalar uchun. Shunday qilib, ha, ehtimol juda ko'p. Men undan narsalarni qidirish uchun foydalanaman.
questions.uzSampleBand6: E-e, ochig'ini aytsam, menimcha, men balki shunday qilayotgandirman. Ya'ni, hozirgi kunda bunday qilmaslik qiyin, to'g'rimi? Menga u ishim uchun kerak va, albatta, do'stlar bilan aloqada bo'lish uchun. Men o'ylaymanki, ijtimoiy tarmoqlarni qisqartirishim mumkin, lekin u juda o'rgatib qo'yadi.
questions.uzSampleBand7: Ha, men anchayin aminmanki, shunday qilaman. Bu kerakli yovuzlik, deb o'ylayman, chunki menga u ish va o'qish uchun kerak. Men undan ko'ngilochar maqsadlarda ham foydalanaman, masalan, filmlar va teleshouvlarni striming qilish uchun. Biroq, men imkon qadar ekran vaqtimni cheklashga harakat qilaman, lekin bu har doim ham oson emas. Bu doimiy kurash.
questions.uzSampleBand8: Menimcha, men Internetdan kerakligidan ko'proq foydalanaman. U zamonaviy hayotning ajralmas qismiga aylandi, ayniqsa ish va aloqa uchun. Shunga qaramay, men uning potentsial kamchiliklaridan xabardorman, masalan, ko'z zo'riqishi va ijtimoiy tarmoqlarning quyon teshigi. Shunday qilib, men faol ravishda o'chirishga va boshqa faoliyatlar bilan shug'ullanishga harakat qilaman, masalan, kitob o'qish yoki sayr qilish, sog'lom muvozanatni saqlash uchun. Men aniq ko'proq intizomli bo'lishim mumkin deb o'ylayman.
questions.uzSampleBand9: Shubhasiz, men Internetdan haddan tashqari foydalanaman deb gumon qilaman. Bu mening kasbim uchun zarur vosita va men undan aloqada bo'lish va xabardor bo'lish uchun ham foydalanaman. Shunga qaramay, men uning vaqtimni yeb qo'yish va meni yanada mazmunli mashg'ulotlardan chalg'itish potentsialidan juda yaxshi xabardorman. Asosiysi, barqaror muvozanatni topish va men doimo onlayn bo'lmagan faoliyatlar bilan ongli ravishda shug'ullanib, haddan tashqari ekran vaqtidan o'zimni chetlatishga harakat qilaman. Men ko'proq e'tiborli bo'lishga va befarq ko'rish odatini buzishga harakat qilyapman.
questions.uzSampleAnswer: Rostini aytsam, ha—va menimcha, bu savolga aksariyat odamlar o'ylab ko'rib, xuddi shunday javob berishadi. Internet, ayniqsa ijtimoiy tarmoqlar va yangiliklar platformalari, siz u yerda qancha vaqt o'tkazishingizni maksimal darajada oshirish uchun katta murakkablik bilan yaratilgan va men ba'zida ulardan haqiqiy ehtiyojdan ko'ra, zerikish yoki xavotirlikdan telefonimga qo'l uzatish kabi odatiy usullarda foydalanayotganimni sezaman. Vaqt o'tishi bilan men bunga ko'proq e'tiborli bo'ldim va foydalanishimga ko'proq ongli yondashishga harakat qildim—bildirishnomalarni o'chirish, telefonsiz davrlarni belgilash va onlayn bo'lganimda nimaga erishmoqchi ekanligim haqida ko'proq o'ylab ko'rish. Menimcha, asosiy farq Internetdan vosita sifatida—aniq bir narsaga erishish uchun—va undan vaqtni to'ldirish yoki noqulaylikni bartaraf etish uchun odatiy mashg'ulot sifatida foydalanish o'rtasida. Birinchisi haqiqatan ham qimmatli; ikkinchisi meni avvalgidan ko'ra ko'proq chalg'itadi va kamroq qoniqish hissini qoldiradi. Menimcha, yechim Internetdan qochish emas, bu na real va na istalgan narsa, balki u bilan yanada ongli va anglangan munosabatlarni rivojlantirishdir.

questions.prompt: What would you like to change about your lifestyle?

vocabulary.title: Q4 - Changes to Your Lifestyle
phrases: difficult to maintain as a habit
sentenceStarters: If I'm being honest with myself...
The most significant would be to be more consistent...
More broadly, I'd like to be more intentional...

questions.sampleBand5: Well, honestly, I want to, um, wake up earlier. I usually go to bed late. It's not good. So, yeah, I want to change that.
questions.sampleBand6: Um, I think I'd like to cut down on my screen time. I probably spend too much time on my phone and laptop. It's a bad time management habit, and I should break it up to be more productive, I think.
questions.sampleBand7: Well, I'd really like to improve my diet. I know I don't eat enough vegetables, and I tend to rely on convenience foods too much. I supposedly should start cooking more, which is something I've been meaning to do for ages. It would definitely make me feel healthier overall.
questions.sampleBand8: If I could change one thing, it would be to incorporate more physical activity into my daily routine. I work a sedentary job, and while I go to the gym occasionally, it's not consistent enough. I'd like to make a conscious effort to walk more, maybe even cycle to work if the weather permits. I think it would do wonders for my physical and mental well-being. Plus, I'd love to get back into playing tennis.
questions.sampleBand9: That's an interesting question. Honestly, I'd love to cultivate a greater sense of mindfulness in my life. I find myself constantly getting caught up in the hustle and bustle, and I rarely take the time to truly appreciate the present moment. I'd like to start practicing meditation regularly, or perhaps even take a yoga class. Ultimately, I believe that slowing down and being more present would have a profound impact on my overall well-being and allow me to recharge my batteries more effectively.
questions.sampleAnswer: If I'm being honest with myself, the changes I'd most like to make are ones I'm already aware of but find difficult to implement consistently—which I think is a fairly universal human experience. The most significant would be to be more consistent about physical exercise—I know the evidence for its benefits is overwhelming, and I feel better when I do it regularly, but I find it difficult to maintain as a habit when life gets busy. I'd also like to reduce my screen time, particularly in the evenings—I think the habit of looking at screens late at night affects my sleep quality and my ability to wind down. More broadly, I'd like to be more intentional about how I spend my time—to be more deliberate about prioritising the things that genuinely matter to me rather than letting the urgent crowd out the important. I think the gap between knowing what would improve your life and actually doing it consistently is one of the central challenges of modern life, and I don't think I'm unusual in finding it difficult to bridge.
questions.uzSampleBand5: Xo'sh, rostini aytsam, men, e-e, erta uyg'onmoqchiman. Men odatda kech yotaman. Bu yaxshi emas. Shunday ekan, ha, men buni o'zgartirmoqchiman.

questions.uzSampleBand7: Xo'sh, men o'z ovqatlanishimni yaxshilashni juda xohlardim. Bilaman, men etarli sabzavot yemayman va ko'pincha qulay ovqatlarga tayanaman. Men go'yoki ko'proq ovqat pishirishni boshlashim kerak, bu men ko'pdan beri qilmoqchi bo'lgan narsa. Bu meni albatta umuman sog'lomroq his qilishimga olib keladi.
questions.uzSampleBand8: Agar bitta narsani o'zgartira olsam, bu kundalik hayotimga ko'proq jismoniy faollikni kiritish bo'lardi. Men harakatsiz ishda ishlayman va vaqti-vaqti bilan sport zaliga borsam ham, bu etarli emas. Men ko'proq piyoda yurishga, hatto ob-havo ruxsat bersa, velosipedda ishga borishga ham ongli harakat qilishni xohlardim. O'ylaymanki, bu mening jismoniy va ruhiy farovonligim uchun mo'jizalar yaratadi. Bundan tashqari, men tennis o'ynashga qaytishni xohlardim.
questions.uzSampleBand9: Bu qiziqarli savol. Rostini aytsam, men hayotimda ko'proq onglilik hissini rivojlantirishni xohlardim. Men doimo g'alva ichida qolib ketayotganimni sezaman va hozirgi lahzani haqiqatan ham qadrlashga kamdan-kam vaqt ajrataman. questions.sampleAnswer: I think the answer varies enormously depending on who you're talking about and where in the world they live. In many developed economies, there's a paradox: people have more labour-saving technology than any previous generation, yet many report feeling more time-pressured than ever. Part of this is structural—longer working hours, longer commutes, and the blurring of work and personal life enabled by smartphones have eaten into what was previously leisure time. Part of it is psychological—the expansion of what people feel they should be doing with their time, including self-improvement, social media maintenance, and the management of increasingly complex lives. There are also significant inequalities in free time—people in lower-income jobs often have less control over their schedules and less genuine leisure time than those in professional roles. And globally, the picture is even more unequal—in many parts of the world, the demands of subsistence leave little room for leisure at all. questions.sampleAnswer:
I'd like to talk about an invention that I think is genuinely underappreciated given how profoundly it has transformed daily life—the smartphone.

The smartphone is, at its core, a pocket-sized computer with wireless connectivity, a camera, and a suite of sensors, combined with an ecosystem of applications that can perform an almost unlimited range of functions. What makes it remarkable is not any single capability but the convergence of so many capabilities in a single device that is always with you.

In terms of how it changed the world, the smartphone's impact has been nothing short of revolutionary—and I mean that in both the positive and the more ambivalent senses of the word. It has fundamentally altered how people communicate, access information, navigate, shop, bank, and entertain themselves. It has created entirely new industries—the app economy, the gig economy, social media platforms—and disrupted or destroyed many existing ones. It has given people in developing countries access to banking, healthcare information, and economic opportunities that were previously unavailable to them. It has also changed social behaviour in ways that are still being understood—the way people interact in public spaces, the nature of attention and distraction, the relationship between work and personal life.

In terms of popularity, the smartphone is arguably the most rapidly and widely adopted technology in human history. Within roughly fifteen years of the first modern smartphone, billions of people around the world were using them daily. In many countries, smartphone penetration exceeds ninety percent of the adult population, and in some contexts—particularly in developing economies—the smartphone is the primary or only device through which people access the internet.

For me personally, the smartphone is useful in ways that are both mundane and significant—for navigation, communication, reading, listening to music, managing my schedule, and accessing information instantly. I try to be conscious of its less positive effects on my attention and my relationship with the present moment, but I think it's genuinely one of the most useful objects ever created.

questions.uzSampleAnswer:
Men shunday bir ixtiro haqida gapirmoqchiman, menimcha, u kundalik hayotni qanchalik chuqur o'zgartirganini hisobga olsak, chinakam qadrlanmaydi – bu smartfon.

Smartfon, mohiyatan, simsiz ulanishga, kameraga va sensorlar to'plamiga ega cho'ntak kompyuteridir, deyarli cheksiz funksiyalarni bajarishi mumkin bo'lgan ilovalar ekotizimi bilan birlashtirilgan. Uni ajoyib qiladigan narsa na biror bir qobiliyat, balki siz bilan doimo birga bo'lgan yagona qurilmada juda ko'p qobiliyatlarning mujassamligidir.

U dunyoni qanday o'zgartirgani nuqtai nazaridan, smartfonning ta'siri inqilobiy bo'ldi - va men buni so'zning ijobiy va yanada ambivalently ma'nolarida nazarda tutyapman. U odamlarning muloqot qilish, ma'lumot olish, navigatsiya qilish, xarid qilish, bank xizmatlaridan foydalanish va o'zlarini ko'ngil ochish usullarini tubdan o'zgartirdi. U butunlay yangi sohalarni yaratdi - ilova iqtisodiyoti, gig iqtisodiyoti, ijtimoiy media platformalari - va mavjud bo'lgan ko'plab sohalarni yo'q qildi yoki buzdi. U rivojlanayotgan mamlakatlardagi odamlarga ilgari ularga mavjud bo'lmagan bank xizmatlari, sog'liqni saqlash ma'lumotlari va iqtisodiy imkoniyatlardan foydalanish imkoniyatini berdi. Shuningdek, u ijtimoiy xulq-atvorni hali ham tushunilayotgan usullarda o'zgartirdi - odamlarning jamoat joylarida o'zaro munosabatlari, e'tibor va chalg'itish tabiati, ish va shaxsiy hayot o'rtasidagi munosabatlar.

Ommabopligi nuqtai nazaridan, smartfon, ehtimol, insoniyat tarixidagi eng tez va keng tarqalgan texnologiyadir. Birinchi zamonaviy smartfondan taxminan o'n besh yil ichida dunyo bo'ylab milliardlab odamlar ulardan har kuni foydalanmoqda. Ko'pgina mamlakatlarda smartfonlarning tarqalishi kattalar aholisining to'qson foizidan oshadi va ba'zi kontekstlarda, ayniqsa, rivojlanayotgan iqtisodiyotlarda smartfon odamlarning internetga kirish uchun asosiy yoki yagona qurilmasidir.

Men uchun shaxsan, smartfon navigatsiya, aloqa, o'qish, musiqa tinglash, jadvalimni boshqarish va ma'lumotga bir zumda kirish kabi ham oddiy, ham muhim usullarda foydalidir. Men uning e'tiborimga va hozirgi lahza bilan munosabatlarimga ta'sirining kamroq ijobiy ta'sirlaridan xabardor bo'lishga harakat qilaman, lekin menimcha, bu haqiqatan ham yaratilgan eng foydali narsalardan biridir.

I'm also genuinely uncertain about some of the psychological and social effects of recent digital technologies—the evidence on social media's effects on mental health, particularly for young people, is concerning. History provides numerous examples of inventions whose net effects have been harmful—weapons technologies, certain industrial chemicals, and various forms of addictive or manipulative technology have caused enormous harm. However, I think the more nuanced and accurate picture is that most inventions have mixed effects—they bring genuine benefits to some people in some contexts while causing harm to others or creating unintended consequences that weren't anticipated at the time of invention. The automobile is a good example: it transformed mobility and enabled economic development on a massive scale, but it also created air pollution, urban sprawl, road deaths, and—through its contribution to carbon emissions—climate change. I think the key insight is that the effects of an invention depend not just on the technology itself but on how it's deployed, governed, and distributed. The same technology can be enormously beneficial or deeply harmful depending on the social, economic, and political context in which it operates. This is why governance and regulation of technology matters so much—the technology itself is rarely the whole story.

Therefore, taraqqiyot hammaga in the long run foyda keltirishini ta'minlash uchun ixtiroga tanqidiy va axloqiy yondashuv zarur.
questions.uzSampleAnswer: Yo'q, va menimcha, barcha innovatsiyalar o'z-o'zidan yaxshi deb hisoblaydigan sodda texnologik optimizmga tayanib qolmasdan, bu haqda aniq fikrda bo'lish muhim. Tarixda sof ta'siri zararli bo'lgan ixtirolarning ko'plab misollari mavjud — qurol texnologiyalari, ba'zi sanoat kimyoviy moddalari va turli xil qaramlik yoki manipulyatsiya qiluvchi texnologiyalar juda katta zarar keltirdi. Biroq, menimcha, yanada nozik va aniqroq tasvir shundan iboratki, ko'pgina ixtirolar aralash ta'sirga ega — ular ba'zi odamlarga ba'zi kontekstlarda haqiqiy foyda keltiradi, boshqalarga zarar keltiradi yoki ixtiro qilingan paytda kutilmagan oqibatlarni keltirib chiqaradi. Avtomobil yaxshi misol: u harakatlanishni o'zgartirdi va keng miqyosda iqtisodiy rivojlanishga imkon berdi, lekin u havo ifloslanishi, shahar tarqalishi, yo'l o'limlari va — karbonat angidrid chiqindilariga qo'shgan hissasi orqali — iqlim o'zgarishini ham yaratdi. Menimcha, asosiy tushuncha shundaki, ixtironing ta'siri nafaqat texnologiyaning o'ziga, balki uning qanday joylashtirilishi, boshqarilishi va tarqatilishiga ham bog'liq. Xuddi shu texnologiya ijtimoiy, iqtisodiy va siyosiy kontekstda qanday ishlashiga qarab juda foydali yoki juda zararli bo'lishi mumkin. Shuning uchun texnologiyani boshqarish va tartibga solish juda muhim — texnologiyaning o'zi deyarli butun hikoya emas.

questions.sampleBand9: That's a fascinating question that cuts to the heart of innovation policy. Ideally, both governments and private companies should be involved, but in different ways. Governments can foster a supportive ecosystem through funding basic research, providing tax incentives, and establishing intellectual property protections. Private companies, driven by the profit motive, are then incentivized to take those innovations and run with them, developing them into commercially viable products and services. A healthy balance between public support and private enterprise is crucial for sustained progress. Moreover, this fosters healthy competition.
questions.sampleAnswer: I think the honest answer is that both have essential and complementary roles to play, and the most productive innovation ecosystems tend to be those that combine the strengths of both rather than relying exclusively on either. Governments are uniquely positioned to fund basic research—the kind of fundamental scientific inquiry that may not have obvious commercial applications but that provides the foundational knowledge from which practical innovations eventually emerge. The internet, GPS, and many pharmaceutical breakthroughs originated in government-funded research. Governments can also direct research toward socially important problems that the market underinvests in—neglected tropical diseases, climate adaptation, public health infrastructure—because the potential returns don't justify private investment. Private companies, on the other hand, are often better at the later stages of innovation—taking a technology from proof of concept to commercially viable product, scaling it, and adapting it to meet real market needs. The competitive pressure of the market creates powerful incentives for efficiency and improvement that government programmes often lack. I think the ideal is a strong public investment in basic research and in areas where market incentives are insufficient, combined with a regulatory environment that enables private innovation while preventing the worst harms.

vocabulary.title: Q13 - Qualities of a Scientist or Inventor

questions.sampleAnswer: The qualities that make a great scientist or inventor are more varied and more human than the stereotypical image of the lone genius working in isolation might suggest. Curiosity is perhaps the most fundamental—a genuine, sustained interest in understanding how things work and why, and a willingness to pursue that interest even when the path is unclear. Closely related is the capacity to tolerate uncertainty and ambiguity—science and invention involve working at the frontier of knowledge, where the answers aren't known and the path forward isn't obvious, and this requires a psychological comfort with not knowing that many people find difficult. Creativity is essential—the ability to see connections between apparently unrelated things, to approach problems from unexpected angles, and to imagine possibilities that don't yet exist. Persistence and resilience are also crucial—most scientific and inventive work involves far more failure than success, and the ability to learn from failure and continue is what distinguishes those who make breakthroughs from those who give up. Rigour and intellectual honesty are equally important—the willingness to subject your ideas to genuine scrutiny, to acknowledge when the evidence doesn't support your hypothesis, and to change your mind when the evidence demands it. And increasingly, the ability to collaborate and communicate is essential—most significant scientific advances today are the product of teams rather than individuals.

questions.uzSampleAnswer: Ajoyib olim yoki ixtirochini yaratadigan sifatlar, yolg'iz daho izolyatsiyada ishlaydi degan stereotipik tasavvurdan ko'ra, ancha xilma-xil va insoniylik xususiyatlariga ega. questions.sampleAnswer: The past century has been extraordinarily productive in terms of invention, and choosing the most important is genuinely difficult because importance can be measured in different ways—by the number of lives saved, by the transformation of daily life, by economic impact, or by the opening of new possibilities. The Green Revolution—the development of high-yield crop varieties and modern agricultural techniques—prevented famines that would otherwise have killed hundreds of millions of people. And I'd argue that contraception deserves recognition as one of the most transformative inventions of the twentieth century—it gave women unprecedented control over their reproductive lives and fundamentally altered the social and economic position of women in society.

questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, many—and I think some of the most important ones are those that don't get the attention they deserve because they're less glamorous than the headline technologies. Clean water infrastructure—the combination of water treatment, sanitation systems, and distribution networks—has probably saved more lives than any other invention by preventing the waterborne diseases that were among the leading causes of death throughout human history. Refrigeration transformed food safety and nutrition by making it possible to store and transport food without spoilage, dramatically reducing food-borne illness and enabling year-round access to a wider range of foods. The printing press—though older than a century—fundamentally changed the relationship between knowledge and power by making information accessible to ordinary people rather than restricted to elites. Solar panels and wind turbines represent an ongoing invention that I think will prove to be among the most important of the twenty-first century—the ability to generate clean energy at scale is essential to addressing climate change. And I'd mention oral rehydration therapy—a remarkably simple invention consisting of water, salt, and sugar—which has saved millions of children's lives by treating dehydration from diarrhoeal diseases in settings where more sophisticated medical care is unavailable.
questions.uzSampleBand5: Xo'sh, hm, balki internet? Menimcha, u narsalarni osonlashtiradi. Masalan, ma'lumot topish uchun. Hm, u foydali. Lekin ba'zan u yaxshi emas, deb o'ylayman. Unda ba'zi muammolar bor.
questions.uzSampleBand6: Hm, menimcha dunyoni yaxshiroq qilgan yana bir ixtiro bu mobil telefon bo'lishi mumkin. Aytmoqchimanki, u aloqa uchun juda foydali va, odamlar bilan aloqada bo'lib turish uchun. Garchi, ba'zan odamlar ularga juda ko'p tayanadi va bu muammo bo'lishi mumkin. Lekin umuman olganda, bu ijobiy narsa.
questions.uzSampleBand7: Xo'sh, albatta internet transformatsion bo'ldi. U aloqani va ma'lumotga kirishni inqilob qildi. Biroq, biz vaksinalar kabi narsalarni ham ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak, deb o'ylayman. Ular kasalliklarni yo'q qildi va olib keldi uzoqroq, sog'lom hayotga. Albatta, ularning xavfsizligi haqida bahslar bor, lekin umuman olganda, ular insoniyat uchun juda foydali bo'ldi.
questions.uzSampleBand8: Bu yaxshi savol. Menimcha internet bilan bir qatorda, men antibiotiklarni ta'kidlagan bo'lardim. Ular sog'liqni saqlashga sezilarli ta'sir ko'rsatdi, bir vaqtlar o'limga olib kelgan bakterial infektsiyalardan son-sanoqsiz hayotni saqlab qoldi. Albatta, hozir antibiotik rezistentligi muammosi bor, bu jiddiy tashvish, lekin orqaga qarab, ularning kashfiyoti hal qiluvchi lahza edi. Va albatta, zamonaviy sanitariya tizimlari ham jamoat salomatligini keskin yaxshiladi.
questions.uzSampleBand9: Xo'sh, tashqari internet kabi aniq tanlovlardan, men qishloq xo'jaligi texnologiyasidagi yutuqlar dunyoni tubdan yaxshilaganini ta'kidlagan bo'lardim. Sug'orish tizimlari va genetik modifikatsiyalangan ekinlar kabi narsalar oziq-ovqat ishlab chiqarishni sezilarli darajada oshirdi, bu ko'plab mintaqalarda ochlik va to'yib ovqatlanmaslikka qarshi kurashishga yordam beradi. Tabiiyki, axloqiy masalalarni va potentsial ekologik ta'sirlarni ko'rib chiqish kerak, lekin oxir oqibat, bu yangiliklar o'sib borayotgan global aholini boqishda hal qiluvchi rol o'ynadi. Bundan tashqari, qayta tiklanadigan energiya manbalarini rivojlantirish barqaror kelajak uchun tobora muhim ahamiyat kasb etmoqda.
questions.uzSampleAnswer: Ha, ko'plab—va menimcha, eng muhimlaridan ba'zilari e'tiborga loyiq bo'lsa-da, ommabop texnologiyalardan kamroq jozibali bo'lganligi sababli, yetarli e'tiborga ega bo'lmaydi. Toza suv infratuzilmasi—suvni tozalash, sanitariya tizimlari va tarqatish tarmoqlarining kombinatsiyasi—insoniyat tarixida o'limga olib keluvchi asosiy sabablardan biri bo'lgan suv orqali yuqadigan kasalliklarning oldini olish orqali boshqa har qanday ixtirodan ko'ra ko'proq hayotni saqlab qolgan bo'lishi mumkin. Sovutgich oziq-ovqat xavfsizligi va ovqatlanishni o'zgartirdi, oziq-ovqatni buzilmasdan saqlash va tashish imkonini berdi, oziq-ovqatdan zaharlanishni keskin kamaytirdi va yil davomida turli xil oziq-ovqatlardan foydalanish imkonini berdi. Bosmaxona—bir asrdan ko'proq eski bo'lsa-da—ma'lumotni elita uchun emas, balki oddiy odamlar uchun ochiq qilib, bilim va hokimiyat o'rtasidagi munosabatni tubdan o'zgartirdi. Quyosh panellari va shamol turbinalari davom etayotgan ixtironi ifodalaydi, menimcha, yigirma birinchi asrning eng muhimlaridan biri bo'ladi—keng miqyosda toza energiya ishlab chiqarish qobiliyati iqlim o'zgarishiga qarshi kurashish uchun zarur. Va men og'iz orqali rehidratatsiya terapiyasini eslatib o'tmoqchiman—suv, tuz va shakardan iborat juda oddiy ixtiro—murakkabroq tibbiy yordam mavjud bo'lmagan sharoitlarda diareya kasalliklaridan suvsizlanishni davolash orqali millionlab bolalarning hayotini saqlab qoldi.

questions.prompt: How has technology changed the way people work?

vocabulary.title: Q16 - How Technology Changed Work
idioms: the shape of things to come
phrases: boundary between work and personal life
sentenceStarters: Technology has transformed work in ways...
The nature of many jobs has changed fundamentally...
I think the most important question for the coming decades...

questions.sampleBand5: Well, um, I think technology makes it easier to do work. Like, you can send emails faster. And, uh, you can, like, find information, um, on the computer. It's, uh, pretty useful.
questions.sampleBand6: I mean, obviously, technology has had a big impact. It's made communication easier, so things get done faster. Um, people can work from home now, which is a big change, but sometimes it can be a bit distracting, I think.
questions.sampleBand7: Technology has definitely revolutionised the workplace. I mean, it's allowed for greater efficiency and productivity. For instance, automation has taken over many repetitive tasks. Also, the rise of remote work means people can work from anywhere, although this can blur the lines between work and personal life.
questions.sampleBand8: Technology has fundamentally reshaped how people work. Essentially, it's increased efficiency and collaboration. We can now outsource tasks globally and access information instantly. On the one hand, this has created opportunities, but on the other hand, it's also led to job displacement and increased pressure to be constantly connected. Companies now rely heavily on technology.
questions.sampleBand9: Technology has irrevocably transformed the modern workplace; it's a double-edged sword, really. On the one hand, automation and AI have streamlined processes, leading to increased productivity and allowing employees to focus on more creative and strategic tasks. Moreover, the rise of remote work, facilitated by cloud computing and high-speed internet, has offered unprecedented flexibility. However, this constant connectivity can take its toll, blurring the boundaries between work and personal life, and potentially exacerbating stress and burnout. The digital divide is also a concern, as not everyone has equal access to these technologies.
questions.sampleAnswer: Technology has transformed work in ways that are so pervasive that it's difficult to imagine what work looked like before. The most obvious change is in the tools of work—computers, the internet, and software have replaced or transformed virtually every category of knowledge work, making it faster, more connected, and more capable of handling complexity. The nature of many jobs has changed fundamentally—roles that once required physical presence can now be done remotely, which the pandemic demonstrated at scale and which has permanently altered expectations about where and how work happens. Automation has eliminated many routine and repetitive tasks—both manual and cognitive—and this process is accelerating with the development of artificial intelligence. This creates both opportunities and anxieties: opportunities for people to focus on more creative and interpersonal aspects of work, and anxieties about job displacement and the future of employment. The boundary between work and personal life has also been significantly eroded by technology—the ability to be reached at any time and to work from anywhere has made it harder to maintain a clear separation between the two. I think the most important question for the coming decades is how the gains from technological productivity are distributed—whether they flow primarily to capital owners or are shared more broadly with workers and society.
questions.uzSampleBand5: Xo'sh, e-e, menimcha texnologiya ishni bajarishni osonlashtiradi. Masalan, elektron pochtalarni tezroq yuborishingiz mumkin. Va, e-e, kompyuterda, e-e, ma'lumotlarni topishingiz mumkin. Bu, e-e, juda foydali.
questions.uzSampleBand6: Aytmoqchimanki, aniqki, texnologiya katta ta'sir ko'rsatdi. Bu aloqani osonlashtirdi, shunday qilib, ishlar tezroq bajariladi. E-e, odamlar endi uydan ishlashi mumkin, bu katta o'zgarish, lekin ba'zida bu biroz chalg'ituvchi bo'lishi mumkin, deb o'ylayman.
questions.uzSampleBand7: Texnologiya, albatta, ish joyini inqilob qildi. Aytmoqchimanki, bu katta samaradorlik va unumdorlikni ta'minladi. Misol uchun, avtomatlashtirish ko'plab takroriy vazifalarni o'z zimmasiga oldi. Shuningdek, masofaviy ishning rivojlanishi odamlarning istalgan joydan ishlashi mumkinligini anglatadi, garchi bu ish va shaxsiy hayot o'rtasidagi chegaralarni xiralashtirishi mumkin.
questions.uzSampleBand8: Texnologiya odamlarning ishlash usulini tubdan o'zgartirdi. Aslida, bu samaradorlik va hamkorlikni oshirdi. Endi biz vazifalarni global miqyosda autsorsing qila olamiz va ma'lumotlarga bir zumda kirishimiz mumkin. Bir tomondan, bu imkoniyatlar yaratdi, lekin boshqa tomondan, bu ish o'rinlarini yo'qotishga va doimiy ravishda bog'langan bo'lish uchun bosimning oshishiga ham olib keldi. Kompaniyalar endi texnologiyaga juda bog'liq.
questions.uzSampleBand9: Texnologiya zamonaviy ish joyini qaytarib bo'lmaydigan darajada o'zgartirdi; bu ikki tomonlama qilich, aslida. Bir tomondan, avtomatlashtirish va sun'iy intellekt jarayonlarni soddalashtirdi, bu esa unumdorlikni oshirdi va xodimlarga yanada ijodiy va strategik vazifalarga e'tibor qaratish imkonini berdi. Bundan tashqari, bulutli hisoblash va yuqori tezlikdagi internet yordamida masofaviy ishning rivojlanishi misli ko'rilmagan moslashuvchanlikni taklif qildi. Biroq, bu doimiy ulanish o'z ta'sirini ko'rsatishi, ish va shaxsiy hayot o'rtasidagi chegaralarni xiralashtirishi va potentsial ravishda stress va charchoqni kuchaytirishi mumkin. Raqamli tafovut ham tashvish tug'diradi, chunki hamma ham bu texnologiyalarga teng darajada ega emas.
questions.uzSampleAnswer: Texnologiya ish usullarini shunchalik keng qamrovli o'zgartirdiki, ilgari ish qanday bo'lganini tasavvur qilish qiyin. Eng aniq o'zgarish ish vositalarida - kompyuterlar, internet va dasturiy ta'minot deyarli har bir bilim ishini almashtirdi yoki o'zgartirdi, uni tezroq, bog'langanroq va murakkablikni hal qilishga qodir qildi. Ko'pgina ishlarning tabiati tubdan o'zgardi - bir vaqtlar jismoniy hozir bo'lishni talab qiladigan rollarni endi masofadan turib bajarish mumkin, buni pandemiya keng miqyosda ko'rsatdi va bu ish qayerda va qanday bo'lishi haqidagi taxminlarni doimiy ravishda o'zgartirdi. Avtomatlashtirish ko'plab odatiy va takroriy vazifalarni - ham qo'lda, ham kognitiv - yo'q qildi va bu jarayon sun'iy intellektning rivojlanishi bilan tezlashmoqda. Bu ham imkoniyatlar, ham tashvishlar yaratadi: odamlarning ishning yanada ijodiy va shaxslararo jihatlariga e'tibor qaratish imkoniyatlari, ish o'rinlarini yo'qotish va bandlik kelajagi haqidagi tashvishlar. Ish va shaxsiy hayot o'rtasidagi chegara ham texnologiya tomonidan sezilarli darajada buzilgan - istalgan vaqtda bog'lanish va istalgan joydan ishlash imkoniyati ikkalasi o'rtasida aniq ajratishni saqlashni qiyinlashtirdi. O'ylashimcha, kelgusi o'n yilliklar uchun eng muhim savol - texnologik unumdorlikdan olinadigan foyda qanday taqsimlanadi - ular asosan kapital egalariga oqib o'tadimi yoki ishchilar va jamiyat bilan kengroq baham ko'riladimi.

questions.prompt: What inventions do you think will be developed in the future?

vocabulary.title: Q17 - Future Inventions
sentenceStarters: I think the most transformative inventions...
Artificial intelligence is the most obvious...
I'm also watching developments in materials science...

questions.sampleBand5: Well, um, I think maybe robots will, like, do more things. And, um, maybe cars that can fly? I think that would be, um, very cool. I'm not sure what else, but yeah, flying cars, I guess. It's hard to say honestly.
questions.sampleBand6: I think we'll probably see more advancements in AI, particularly in areas like healthcare. Maybe robots that can perform surgery, or even diagnose illnesses. And, um, I guess there will be some breakthroughs in renewable energy too. Although, it's hard to predict exactly what they'll be.
questions.sampleBand7: It's interesting to think about. I imagine we'll see further developments in personalized medicine, maybe even gene editing to prevent diseases. Also, I think sustainable technologies will become more prevalent. Perhaps we'll come up with new ways to harness energy from the sun or wind, or even develop completely new energy sources. It's all quite exciting, really.
questions.sampleBand8: Well, I think we're on the cusp of some pretty significant technological advancements. I suspect we'll see widespread adoption of personalized AI assistants that can take care of many mundane tasks. Furthermore, I wouldn't be surprised if we see some major breakthroughs in quantum computing, which could really revolutionize fields like medicine and materials science. And, of course, space exploration will continue to make progress, perhaps leading to lunar or even Martian settlements in the not-too-distant future.
questions.sampleBand9: It's fascinating to contemplate the future of invention. I believe we're likely to witness a convergence of technologies, resulting in innovations that are currently unimaginable. For example, I envision advanced bio-integrated technologies that seamlessly merge human biology with artificial intelligence, leading to enhanced cognitive abilities and physical capabilities. Moreover, I anticipate breakthroughs in sustainable materials and energy production, potentially doing away with our reliance on fossil fuels altogether. And, to top it all off, the exploration of space will undoubtedly yield unexpected discoveries and inventions, perhaps even providing us with new resources and a fresh perspective on our place in the universe. It's a very exciting prospect, really.
questions.sampleAnswer: I think the most transformative inventions of the coming decades will likely emerge from a few areas where the pace of progress is already rapid and where the potential impact is enormous. Artificial intelligence is the most obvious—we're already seeing the early stages of a transformation that I think will be as significant as the industrial revolution, affecting virtually every domain of human activity. The specific applications are difficult to predict, but AI systems that can perform complex cognitive tasks—diagnosis, research, design, teaching—at scale and at low cost could fundamentally change how knowledge work is done. Clean energy technology—better solar panels, batteries, and potentially fusion power—will be essential to addressing climate change and could also transform energy access in developing countries. Biotechnology and medicine are another area of rapid progress—gene editing, personalised medicine, and potentially treatments for currently incurable diseases like Alzheimer's could transform human health and longevity. I'm also watching developments in materials science—new materials with extraordinary properties could enable technologies that are currently impossible. And I think there will be inventions we can't currently anticipate—the history of technology suggests that the most transformative innovations often come from unexpected directions and solve problems that weren't previously recognised as problems.
questions.uzSampleBand5: Xo'sh, mm, menimcha, ehtimol, robotlar ko'proq narsalarni qiladi. Va, mm, balki ucha oladigan mashinalar? O'ylashimcha, bu, mm, juda zo'r bo'lardi. Boshqa nima bo'lishini bilmayman, lekin ha, uchar mashinalar, deb o'ylayman. Rostini aytsam, aytish qiyin.
questions.uzSampleBand6: O'ylashimcha, biz, ehtimol, Sun'iy intellekt sohasida, ayniqsa sog'liqni saqlash kabi sohalarda ko'proq yutuqlarni ko'ramiz. Balki operatsiya qila oladigan yoki hatto kasalliklarni tashxislash mumkin bo'lgan robotlar. Va, mm, menimcha, qayta tiklanadigan energiya sohasida ham ulkan yutuqlar bo'ladi. Garchi, ularning aynan qanday bo'lishini bashorat qilish qiyin.
questions.uzSampleBand7: Bu haqda o'ylash qiziq. Tasavvur qilishimcha, biz shaxsiy tibbiyot sohasida yanada rivojlanishlarni ko'ramiz, hatto kasalliklarning oldini olish uchun genlarni tahrirlash ham mumkin. Bundan tashqari, menimcha, barqaror texnologiyalar ko'proq tarqaladi. Ehtimol, biz quyosh yoki shamoldan energiya olishning yangi usullarini o'ylab topamiz yoki hatto butunlay yangi energiya manbalarini ishlab chiqamiz. Bu juda hayajonli, rostini aytsam.
questions.uzSampleBand8: Xo'sh, menimcha, biz juda muhim texnologik yutuqlarning arafasida turibmiz. Ko'p zerikarli vazifalarni bajaradigan shaxsiy Sun'iy intellekt yordamchilarining keng tarqalishini ko'ramiz deb o'ylayman. Bundan tashqari, men kvant hisoblash sohasida katta yutuqlarni ko'rsak, hayron bo'lmayman, bu tibbiyot va materialshunoslik kabi sohalarni haqiqatan ham inqilob qilishi mumkin. Va, albatta, kosmosni o'rganish rivojlanishda davom etadi, bu oy yoki hatto Marsda yaqin kelajakda aholi punktlarining paydo bo'lishiga olib kelishi mumkin.
questions.uzSampleBand9: Ixtironing kelajagi haqida o'ylash juda qiziqarli. Menimcha, biz texnologiyalarning konvergentsiyasiga guvoh bo'lamiz, natijada hozirda tasavvur qilib bo'lmaydigan innovatsiyalar paydo bo'ladi. Misol uchun, men inson biologiyasini sun'iy intellekt bilan uzluksiz birlashtiradigan, kognitiv qobiliyatlar va jismoniy imkoniyatlarni oshiradigan ilg'or bio-integratsiyalashgan texnologiyalarni tasavvur qilaman. Bundan tashqari, men barqaror materiallar va energiya ishlab chiqarish sohasida yutuqlarni kutaman, bu potentsial ravishda umuman qazilma yoqilg'iga bo'lgan ehtiyojimizni yo'q qiladi. Va, eng muhimi, kosmosni o'rganish, shubhasiz, kutilmagan kashfiyotlar va ixtirolarga olib keladi, ehtimol, hatto bizga yangi resurslar va koinotdagi o'rnimizga yangi nuqtai nazarni taqdim etadi. Bu juda hayajonli istiqbol, rostini aytsam.
questions.uzSampleAnswer: O'ylashimcha, kelgusi o'n yilliklardagi eng katta o'zgarishlarga olib keladigan ixtirolar, ehtimol, allaqachon tez sur'atlar bilan rivojlanayotgan va potentsial ta'siri juda katta bo'lgan bir nechta sohalarda paydo bo'ladi. Sun'iy intellekt eng aniq misol – biz allaqachon sanoat inqilobi kabi muhim bo'ladigan o'zgarishlarning dastlabki bosqichlarini ko'rmoqdamiz, bu inson faoliyatining deyarli har bir sohasiga ta'sir qiladi. Aniq qo'llanilishini bashorat qilish qiyin, lekin murakkab kognitiv vazifalarni – tashxis qo'yish, tadqiqot o'tkazish, loyihalashtirish, o'qitish – miqyosda va arzon narxda bajaradigan Sun'iy intellekt tizimlari bilimga asoslangan ish usulini tubdan o'zgartirishi mumkin. Toza energiya texnologiyasi – yaxshiroq quyosh panellari, batareyalar va potentsial ravishda termoyadroviy energiya – iqlim o'zgarishiga qarshi kurashish uchun zarur bo'ladi va rivojlanayotgan mamlakatlarda energiya ta'minotini ham o'zgartirishi mumkin. Biotexnologiya va tibbiyot tez rivojlanayotgan yana bir soha – gen tahrirlash, shaxsiy tibbiyot va potentsial ravishda hozirda davosi yo'q bo'lgan Altsgeymer kasalligi kabi kasalliklar uchun davolash usullari inson salomatligi va umrini o'zgartirishi mumkin. Men materialshunoslikdagi rivojlanishlarni ham kuzatib boryapman – g'ayrioddiy xususiyatlarga ega yangi materiallar hozirda imkonsiz bo'lgan texnologiyalarni yaratishi mumkin. Va menimcha, biz hozirda kutmagan ixtirolar ham bo'ladi – texnologiya tarixi shuni ko'rsatadiki, eng katta o'zgarishlarga olib keladigan innovatsiyalar ko'pincha kutilmagan yo'nalishlardan kelib chiqadi va ilgari muammo sifatida tan olinmagan muammolarni hal qiladi.
